title: cantinoa sylvularum
intro: Cantinoa sylvularum, commonly known as Brazilian mint or purple mint, is a species of flowering plant in the family Lamiaceae. This herb is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce stress and promote relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Cantinoa sylvularum include its ability to ease digestive issues, calm anxiety, and soothe skin irritations. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic properties.
